dvids.title: USS Thomas Hudner Returns to Naval Station Mayport from Deployment to U.S. 4th, 5th, and 6th Fleets
dvids.desc:
MAYPORT, Fla. – Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer USS Thomas Hudner (DDG 116) returned to Naval Station Mayport on August 9, concluding an almost nine-month deployment across multiple geographic theaters, including the U.S. 4th, 5th and 6th Fleet areas of operations.
